Alger, 1 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 1, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The mobile telephone operator Mobilis unveiled new applications and digital solutions intended for individual and professional customers, during a ceremony organized in Algiers.
Déploiement de nouvelles applications et: Deployment of new applications and network reinforcement
Le lancement de ces prestations s'est dé: The launch of these services took place in the presence of the President and CEO of Mobilis, Chaouki Boukhazani, representatives of several ministerial departments, as well as leaders of companies and national organizations. Among these tools is the “Mobilis Care” application, designed entirely in-house by the company. This offers the possibility of consulting balances, tracking consumption, recharging accounts, paying bills online, activating 5G services, as well as submitting and tracking complaints.
Pour la clientèle professionnelle, l'opé: For professional customers, the operator provides the “MobiTransfer” application, intended for the management of communication balances and the distribution of Mobilis units (MU) between employees according to work requirements. Mobilis also presented the “M-View” service, which allows video sequences to be viewed on the phone screen while waiting for a call to be answered. This service is offered free of charge during the first year to companies under contract.
Sur le plan des infrastructures, M. Bouk: In terms of infrastructure, Mr. Boukhazani specified that Mobilis has obtained exclusive frequencies in the 2.6 GHz band to optimize network performance and improve the quality of the connection. Furthermore, the “Mobilis Hacking Challenge” competition was initiated in order to detect possible security vulnerabilities on “Mobilis Care”, with a reward set at one million dinars for the winner.
